# HyperKB

> Persistent Markdown memory for MCP clients. Local ripgrep + BM25 search,
> complete context retrieval, and optional Git-backed S3 synchronization.

HyperKB is MIT-licensed Python software. Knowledge lives in topic-named Markdown
files; SQLite is a rebuildable index. Multiple local stdio clients share storage
with coordinated mutations and independent session context. There is no public
HTTP MCP endpoint in this project.

## Project

- [Source](https://github.com/calvincs/hyperkb)
- [Readable documentation](docs/index.html)
- [License](LICENSE)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/calvincs/hyperkb/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Local search needs no model API key. Context token counts are estimates, not a
specific model tokenizer's count. Entries can be amended, so storage is not an
immutable audit log. Upgrade every client sharing a bucket before publishing a
version 2 sync manifest; old clients do not understand immutable blob references.
